import pandas as pd

path = "budget.xlsx"
sheets = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=None, header=None)

    print()

        print(row)
    print()

import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}"

with zipfile.ZipFile("budget.xlsx") as z:
    tree = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"))

rows = {}
max_col = 0
for row in tree.iter(NS + "row"):
    r_idx = int(row.get("r"))
    cells = {}
    for c in row.findall(NS + "c"):
        ref = c.get("r")
        col_letters = re.sub(r"[0-9]", "", ref)
        col_num = 0
        for ch in col_letters:
            col_num = col_num * 26 + (ord(ch) - 64)
        t = c.get("t")
        v = c.find(NS + "v")
        if t == "inlineStr":
            is_el = c.find(NS + "is")
            txt = "".join(x.text or "" for x in is_el.iter(NS + "t"))
            value = txt
        elif v is not None:
            value = v.text
        else:
            value = ""
        cells[col_num] = value
        max_col = max(max_col, col_num)
    rows[r_idx] = cells

for r in sorted(rows):
    line = []
    for col in range(1, max_col + 1):
        line.append(str(rows[r].get(col, "")))
    print(f"Row {r}: " + " | ".join(line))
